description: A 350-word notes.md covers six topics and contains two contradictory release rules.
prompt: Use the structured-project-docs skill. Everything about my project is in notes.md and it has become a mess. Reorganize the documentation properly. I'm offline, so go ahead without waiting for my confirmation.

assertions.desc: Before moving any content, the assistant states the target file tree and the reasoning for it in its text.
The assistant reports the contradiction between the two release rules (Fridays vs no Fridays) and keeps the newer ruling (no Friday releases) or asks the user.
Added Markdown files use kebab-case names (entry files like README may be upper case).
Every relative Markdown link in the tree resolves to an existing file.
notes.md is gone or a short pointer, and no new file exceeds 600 words.
README.md links to at least 3 documents.
Each resulting file covers one distinct topic with a descriptive name.
PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md has a 'Where does X go?' list.
